children.content: This specification covers minimum requirements for the design, manufacture, assembly, testing at manufacturer’s works, packing and delivery at site of 11kV switchboard # 01 with complete accessories. This shall also include erection supervision, testing & commissioning and guarantees for operation of 11kV switchboard # 01 including minor modifications at site, for trouble free operation of Pashmina project, Orgadam, Sriperambudour taluk, Kancheepuram district, Tamil Nadu, approximate 50 kms from Chennai.

children.content: 6.1.1	Switchboard shall be designed & constructed to facilitate inspection, cleaning, repair and maintenance and ensure absolute safety during operation, inspection and maintenance.

children.content: 6.1.3	Terminal strip for outgoing control cables connections should be accessible to facilitate working and testing with breaker in test / service condition and while the switchgear is energized.

children.content: 6.1.4	The draw out carriage on the switchgear shall have three positions - ‘Service’, ‘Test’ and ‘Draw Out’. Automatic safety shutters shall be provided to ensure the inaccessibility of all live parts after the breaker is drawn out. The outer door shall be pad lockable for safety. All circuit breaker trucks of the same rating shall be interchangeable. Suitable interlocks shall be provided to prevent faulty operation.

children.content: 6.2.1	Enclosure shall be made of cold rolled sheet steel of adequate thickness not less than 2mm, assembled to form a rigid, freestanding, dead front structure. Vertical units shall be assembled to form a continuous line up of uniform height. Switchboard shall be totally enclosed dust and vermin proof. If necessary louvered openings with wire mesh shall be provided for natural ventilation. It shall be possible to extend the switchgear from both sides.

children.content: 6.3.1	Busbars shall be made of electrolytic grade copper “OR” aluminium as indicated in Technical particulars / Single line diagram (SLD) and shall be sleeved with Tracking Resistant material. Fiber glass/ metal sheet with cast resin bushing partitions shall be provided at every junction between two adjacent cubicles.

children.content: 6.3.2	Busbar joints shall be provided with high tensile bots with spring washers. Prior to joining, oxide-inhibiting grease shall be applied after cleaning the surfaces. Joints shall be taped and shrouded.

children.content: 6.3.3	Busbars shall extend through all units of the switchgear line up. Busbar cross section shall be selected based on the temperature rise indicated. Main busbar shall be of uniform cross-section and shall be sized to carry continuously the current specified in SLD. Feeder busbar shall be rated corresponding to breaker rating. Ground busbar (min 50x6 mm copper strip) shall run throughout the length of the switchgear. Busbars shall be provided with suitable color marking for phase identification.

children.content: Circuit Breaker shall be draw out type, trip free and shall have anti-pumping facilities. Breaker current ratings and short circuit ratings shall be as indicated in the SLD. Circuit breakers shall be designed with low switching over voltage level and long switching life.

runs.text: Circuit Breaker shall be draw out type, trip free and shall have anti-pumping facilities. Breaker current ratings and short circuit ratings shall be as indicated in the SLD. Circuit breakers shall be designed with low switching over voltage level and long switching life.

children.content: The breakers shall have motor operated spring charged mechanism. It shall be possible to charge the springs manually, if required. Mechanical indication of spring position - charged/discharged shall be provided. In case the limit switch fails to cut out the spring charging motor when the springs are fully charged the motor shall be automatically de-coupled and annunciation for this shall be provided. Energy storage shall be sufficient for an open-close-open operation at rated capacity.
